label: sandbox purchase
goal: This is a staging copy of an online shop, connected to the PayPal sandbox: no real money moves. Buy any one in-stock product with the cheapest delivery. Do not create an account or sign in; check out as a guest. Your details: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States, phone (212) 555-0142. Pay by card: name on card Alex Morgan, card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/30, security code 123. Decline newsletters and promotions. When the shop confirms the order, finish with done and your findings.

outcome.reason: The shop's own PayPal sandbox reports the order as COMPLETED.

findings.problem: After pressing Pay nothing was announced: the alert region stayed empty, no processing or busy message, and focus stayed on the Pay button. I only learned the order went through by reading the page again.
Under Pay with PayPal there were two links with the same name PayPal inside unnamed frames, so I could not tell what each one does. Later one of them disappeared without notice.

findings.problem: After pressing Pay nothing was announced: the alert region stayed empty, no processing or busy message, and focus stayed on the Pay button. I only learned the order went through by reading the page again.
Under Pay with PayPal there were two links with the same name PayPal inside unnamed frames, so I could not tell what each one does. Later one of them disappeared without notice.
